therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: real-time feedback on diminutive use in speech
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: nursing home staff communicating with dementia patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change in elderspeak diminutives per utterance

results.effect_size: minimal differences in diminutive use between groups (0.00-0.03 per utterance)
results.target_engagement_evidence: app detected diminutives with variable accuracy compared to human identification
subgroup_findings: app accuracy varied by diminutive type: 'baby' (100% match), 'honey' (78% match), 'dear' (50% match)

context.indication: elderspeak communication patterns in dementia care
context.investigator_commentary: The clinical trial could not be analyzed due to too few participants (COVID-19 Pandemic)
